parameters.content:
# 🛡️ AI SOC AGENT
## Automated Wazuh Alert Triage & Incident Response

**Flow:** Webhook → Validate → Dedupe → Severity Gate → IOC Extraction → Threat Intel → AI Analysis (Ollama) → Verdict Routing → Safeguarded Auto-Block → IR Report → Slack + Email

**Stack:** n8n · Wazuh · Ollama · AbuseIPDB · VirusTotal · ip-api.com · NVD

---
👤 Built by **@dipnarayannandi**

## ⚙️ Configuration Center
Single source of truth for every tunable — thresholds, allowlists, API endpoints, model name.

## ✅ Input Validation, Dedup & Severity Gate
Rejects malformed alerts, drops duplicates within a rolling window, and filters by severity before anything expensive runs.

## 🌐 Multi-Source Threat Intelligence
IP reputation + geo footprint, malware/hash analysis, and vulnerability/CVSS lookup — each skipped gracefully when the IOC isn't present on the alert.

## 🤖 AI Analysis Pipeline
Local Ollama model performs L1 triage + L2 deep-dive: verdict, confidence, MITRE mapping, kill-chain stage, business impact, recommended actions — as strict JSON.

## 🚫 Auto-Block With Safeguards
Never blocks internal IPs, allowlisted IPs, critical assets, or low-confidence calls. Global kill switch. Every decision is logged with its reason.

## 📣 Critical Response
Verdict = malicious, safeguards passed: full color-coded report by email, one-line alert to Slack.

## 📣 L2 Review & Auto-Close
Suspicious → escalated to L2 (Slack + email). Benign → logged and closed automatically, no page sent.

## ⚠️ Error Handling
A dedicated Error Trigger catches any node failure workflow-wide and pages a Slack channel with the failing node + message.
